summary.oneLiner: Eldeco has transitioned from a land-bank monetization story to a high-growth development phase with the Q4 launch of Solano Gardens (GDV >INR 1,000 Cr), driving 9M FY26 bookings past full-year FY25 levels. The company operates with negative net debt (Cash INR 178 Cr vs Debt INR 106 Cr), providing ample liquidity to fund aggressive land aggregation and construction without equity dilution.

one-line thesis: Eldeco has transitioned from a land-bank monetization story to a high-growth development phase with the Q4 launch of Solano Gardens (GDV >INR 1,000 Cr), driving 9M FY26 bookings past full-year FY25 levels. The company operates with negative net debt (Cash INR 178 Cr vs Debt INR 106 Cr), providing ample liquidity to fund aggressive land aggregation and construction without equity dilution.
financial scorecard: Revenue: INR 45 Cr (Q3); EBITDA: INR 19.8 Cr (43.7% margin, elevated due to Imperia Ph2 mix); PAT: INR 13.7 Cr (30.2% margin); Order Book: Strong pipeline with Solano launch pending full allotment conversion; Net Debt: Negative INR ~72 Cr (Cash INR 178 Cr, Gross Debt INR 106 Cr). One-offs: Bareilly project investment fully recovered with interest (cash inflow, income previously accrued); No major accounting distortions noted beyond standard RERA cash locks.
guidance: Revenue Growth: Imperia Phase 2 to recognize ~INR 299 Cr over next 4-5 quarters; Margin: Sustainable blended EBITDA margin ~30% (near-term higher due to project mix); Order Inflow: Targeting >INR 500 Cr annually as 'new normal' post-Solano launch; Capex: Funded via internal accruals and operating cash flows.
order book & pipeline: 9M FY26 Bookings: INR 361.2 Cr (+29.1% YoY); Area Booked: 5.62 Lakh sq ft (+30% YoY); Key Pipeline: Solano Gardens (Phase 1 launched Jan '26, GDV >INR 1,000 Cr, 20 Lakh sq ft saleable); Eldeco City Courtyard (1.68 acres, 37k sq ft); Eldeco Imperia Avenue (25k sq ft); Unsold Inventory in ongoing projects approx. INR 50 Cr (excl. Imperia Ph2).
segment / subsidiary detail: Residential (Plots/Villas): High margin, primary growth driver (Solano); Group Housing: Lower margin, steady volume; Commercial: <10% of portfolio, opportunistic small projects (City Courtyard, Imperia Avenue).
growth verticals / optionality: Land aggregation targeting 60 acres in near term (currently 40+ acres excluding Solano); Potential undisclosed LDA auction wins (residential); Multi-year up-cycle in Lucknow driven by infrastructure and wage growth.
margins & cost dynamics: Q3 EBITDA margin 43.7% driven by high-margin Imperia Phase 2 deliveries; Sustainable long-term blended margin guided at 30-35%; Plot margins > Group Housing margins; Construction spend 9M FY26: INR 116.5 Cr.
capex / expansion: Funding land acquisition and construction via internal cash flows and Piramal loan (working capital bridge for RERA-locked funds); No heavy external equity raise needed due to negative net debt.
capital allocation: Priority on land aggregation (Lucknow focus); Debt repayment optional due to negative net debt status; Dividend policy not explicitly detailed but cash-rich balance sheet supports potential payouts.
risks & watch-items: Execution risk on Solano Gardens phased launches; Regulatory delays in RERA approvals for new commercial projects; Over-reliance on Lucknow market dynamics; Interest rate sensitivity (though management claims low correlation currently).
management quality / tone: Confident and optimistic; Emphasizes 'multi-year up-cycle' in Lucknow; Transparent about RERA cash locks and debt position; Conservative on pricing sustainability (expects stabilization vs. recent sharp CAGR).
non-obvious takeaways: Negative net debt is structural due to RERA norms (70% collections locked), not just excess cash; Bareilly recovery was an equity instrument with minimum guarantee, now fully unwound; Management hints at undisclosed LDA auction wins not yet in public domain.

themes.title: Real-estate up-cycle - premium housing & redevelopment
themes.need: The residential up-cycle is now presales-led with a visible margin cost. SOBHA posted its highest-ever presales at INR 3,656cr (+76% YoY, 2.34 msf at an average INR 15,655/sqft, NCR at a record INR 1,384cr) and guided FY27 presales at +30% or better - but reported EBITDA is still only ~9.7%, guided to 17-20% only by exit-Q4, and forthcoming-project marginal cash flow was cut from ~INR 86bn to INR 68.3bn on a heavier joint-development mix. SUNTECK booked INR 787cr of presales (+20%) with ZERO launches in the quarter, with aspirational-luxury (Naigaon/Kalyan) at 21% of presales 'picking up because of the lower interest rate' - the first sign the rate-elastic end is turning on demand rather than inventory release. DLF's FY26 bookings of INR20,143cr and 50mn sq ft of rental at 95% occupancy anchor the annuity leg; LODHA/GODREJPROP/PRESTIGE-tier and MMR redevelopers (RUSTOMJEE, KALPATARU, RAYMONDREL, MANINFRA, SURAJEST) ride premiumization; PHOENIXLTD/EMBDL on mixed-use.
themes.driver: SOBHA's exit-Q4 margin ramp from ~9.7% to 17-20% is the falsifiable claim (JD-heavy growth structurally lowers marginal margins); rate-elastic aspirational absorption (SUNTECK); FY27 launch-pipeline execution and festive booking momentum.
